title: Wall Mount Soap Dish Solid Brass 4.5-Inch Dottingham Collection Bath Accessory | Autumn Sparkle | Allied Brass
description:
Add a wall mount soap dish to keep soap handy while reducing countertop clutter in the bathroom in Autumn Sparkle, which captures the rich, warm tones of fall foliage with subtle shimmer, bringing seasonal warmth year-round. This Dottingham collection soap holder / soap dish accessory is crafted from solid brass and installs with concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look.

Highlights:
- Autumn Sparkle transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for an uncluttered appearance
- Installation hardware included; easy to install
- Coordinates with the Dottingham collection for matching transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories

Specs:
- Dimensions: 4.5 in L x 3.5 in W x 3 in H
- Projection: 5 in
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 1.6 lb
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Multiple designer finish options available
